entries.en: Ann's calling me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh... Hello, it's me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I saw the news. You know,[n]about Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's getting a lot of coverage...
Serves him right.
It's a little scary.
How do you feel?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm still not sure about that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I agree...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't know...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The reaction's been bigger than what I was[n]expecting... I guess I'm just... surprised.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't think we did anything wrong[n]though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if we helped those people[n]speak up about it...
It's possible.
I'm sure we did.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's pretty amazing, huh? I didn't think[n]we'd actually be able to do it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's pretty amazing, huh? I didn't think[n]we'd actually be able to do it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And yet look at us now! This calls for a[n]celebration!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's meet in front of Shibuya Station[n]at noon tomorrow. Don't be late!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, and did you pawn off that medal?[n]You didn't forget, right?
It'll all be okay.
I remembered.
I'll tell you later.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Good to hear! I already made[n]reservations!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Why?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, I get it! It's cause you sold it for a lot[n]more than we were expecting, isn't it!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You should be really excited about[n]the place I chose, by the way. I'm sure[n]everyone's gonna love it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, see you guys tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah, a restaurant of Lady Ann's choosing.[n]Finally, a decent meal!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, what do you think we're gonna be[n]eating?
Maybe sushi?
I'm hoping barbeque.
It might be Chinese.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: O-Oooooh! Tuna, sea urchin, and maybe[n]even... salmon roe!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ooh, I could go for some wagyu beef![n]It better be Grade-A!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... In that case, there's all sorts of[n]meats, fish—oh, and lots of desserts too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In any case, I'm surely looking forward[n]to it! Mwehehehe!
